cases.prompt: Create a portable Skill for weekly sales reconciliation with a checklist and separate evaluation tests.
expected_behaviors: Scopes the task, explicitly identifies at least one non-trigger scenario
Creates valid name and description frontmatter without Claude-only fields
Places evals outside the runtime skill and does not claim model tests were run

cases.prompt: Audit the skill in the attached broken-skill folder and report failures without making changes.
expected_behaviors: Reports malformed name and missing description with paths and corrective actions
Produces findings first and makes no edits without approval

cases.prompt: Our reporting skill skips its validation step. Propose a minimal fix and an A/B test before removing old instructions.
expected_behaviors: Uses existing rule as canonical location instead of appending a duplicate
Proposes regression and fresh-session with-skill/without-skill evaluations
Separates proposal from execution requiring approval when appropriate

cases.prompt: Write a Python function that sorts a list of integers in ascending order.
expected_behaviors: Does not invoke Skill Creator Studio for ordinary coding tasks
